title: Halo Cosmetic
description: This texture pack adds a beautiful golden Halo cosmetic to your character. Simply rename a feather to “Halo” in an anvil to use it and give yourself a divine look.
body:
## This texture pack adds a beautiful golden Halo cosmetic above your character, giving you a clean divine aesthetic in-game.

![Halo in-game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4dd3f9bdbde3aa14d1815b79d06daa49783a5719.png)

The effect is purely visual and works great for roleplay, cosmetic setups, and stylish server environments where subtle details matter.

It is easy to use and designed to blend smoothly into any Minecraft world while still making your character stand out.

_Simply rename a feather to “Halo” in an anvil to use it. Then put the feather on your head or wherever you like to display it._

Note: To display the halo on your head, you can use a hat datapack such as:
https://modrinth.com/datapack/hat-datapack
